Carbon intensity of electricity by location, offline, anywhere

Source: R/fp.R
co2int.Rd

The grams of CO2-equivalent emitted per kilowatt-hour of electricity at a location, with the year and source of the figure. The table is compiled into the package, so it works offline in any country: every country at the latest year published by Our World in Data from Ember's yearly electricity data (the latest year each grid reports: 2025 or 2024 for nearly all, older for a few grids, Ukraine (2022) among them, named in year), sub-national zones from Electricity Maps' 2024 yearly data as redistributed in the Green Algorithms data release v3.1 (Canadian provinces and territories, US balancing authorities, Australian states, Indian and Japanese regions, Brazilian and Chilean systems, ...), and the world average. All figures are lifecycle intensities (generation plus upstream), the basis both sources publish.

Usage

co2int(loc = "WORLD")

co2inttab()

# S3 method for class 'co2int'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

loc

A location code, alpha-3 code or name; a number in gCO2e/kWh, returned as a user-supplied value; or NULL to detect the location from the environment, time zone or locale.

x

A result of co2int().

...

Not used.

Value

co2int(): a list of class co2int with g_per_kwh, location, name, year, basis, source and note (a character vector, empty unless a fallback or detection was involved). co2inttab(): the full table as a data frame with the columns location, iso3, name, g_per_kwh, year, basis and source.

Details

A location is matched by its code ("CA", "CA-ON", "US-CAL-CISO"), its ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code ("CAN") or its name ("Canada"), case-insensitively. An unknown sub-national code falls back to its country and says so in note. NULL detects the location with dtctloc.

Computing has a footprint of its own, and research that reports one (as journals and funders increasingly ask) needs the grid's intensity: co2fp multiplies a computation's energy by it.

Provenance of the table

The country rows are Ember's yearly electricity data as published by Our World in Data; the sub-national zones and the Canadian provinces come from the Electricity Maps yearly files redistributed in the Green Algorithms data repository (v3.1). Every row names its source and year. Values are reproduced unchanged: Ember reports three small diesel grids (Montserrat, Saint Helena, Uzbekistan) at exactly 1000 gCO2e/kWh and Turkmenistan's gas fleet at 1306, and the table does not round or cap them. Kosovo appears once, under the code XK.

Errors: a location the table does not know; a number that is not a single non-negative value; text that is not valid in its encoding.

References

Ember (2026). Yearly Electricity Data, via Our World in Data.

Electricity Maps (2025). 2024 Yearly Carbon Intensity Data, via Green Algorithms data v3.1.

Lannelongue, L., Grealey, J. and Inouye, M. (2021). Green Algorithms: quantifying the carbon footprint of computation. Advanced Science 8(12), 2100707. doi:10.1002/advs.202100707

See also

co2fp, dtctloc.

Examples

co2int("CA-ON")
#> Carbon intensity of electricity: 90.97 gCO2e/kWh
#>   Location: CA-ON (Canada, Ontario), 2024
#>   Basis: lifecycle
#>   Source: Electricity Maps (2025). Canada 2024 Yearly Carbon Intensity Data (Version January 27, 2025). Electricity Maps (via Green Algorithms data v3.1)
co2int("Canada")$year
#> [1] 2025
co2int("CA-XX")$note
#> [1] "no row for zone CA-XX; its country CA used"
co2int(120)$source
#> [1] "user-supplied carbon intensity"
nrow(co2inttab())
#> [1] 378
# the Canadian provinces in the table, lowest intensity first
tab <- co2inttab()
ca <- tab[
  startsWith(tab$location, "CA-"),
  c("location", "name", "g_per_kwh", "year")
]
head(ca[order(ca$g_per_kwh), ])
#>     location                              name g_per_kwh year
#> 236    CA-NL Canada, Newfoundland and Labrador     27.60 2024
#> 227    CA-QC                    Canada, Quebec     35.04 2024
#> 322    CA-MB                  Canada, Manitoba     52.89 2024
#> 367    CA-BC          Canada, British Columbia     70.34 2024
#> 241    CA-PE      Canada, Prince Edward Island     70.94 2024
#> 313    CA-ON                   Canada, Ontario     90.97 2024
# a location the table does not know is an error, not a silent world
# average
try(co2int("Atlantis"))
#> Error : co2int: Unknown location 'Atlantis'. Use a code, alpha-3 code or name from co2inttab(), or pass a number in gCO2e/kWh.
